## Today

`ProfileViewModel.init` already collects `linkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()`
(app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt:93-97)
and calls the shared `pushProfile(at)` on each emission, the same
sequence `onSyncClicked` triggers (InProgress → push → Idle/Failure,
see `pushProfile` at line 135). `LinkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()`
(core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/link/LinkStateMonitor.kt:19)
emits on the link becoming established, and since every emission
re-runs `pushProfile`, a push that failed at one link is naturally
retried at the next established link — no separate retry bookkeeping
is needed or missing. This mechanism was built in bugfix-01
(lot-04/lot-05, per their fiche-executable.md), which already states
"retried on the next emission, since observeLinkEstablished() only
fires again on the [next transition]".
